secrets.name: DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer token the dashboard asks for on its login screen and sends to /api/*. The server starts without it, but every /api route then answers 500, so it is needed to sign in and see the dashboard.

secrets.name: GREEN_API_ID_INSTANCE
